text:
You need a motivated beginner-friendly freelancer who is detail-oriented, quick to learn, and comfortable handling data entry, Excel, and basic database-related tasks with accuracy.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I’d be glad to support this role. I bring 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboards, data cleaning, and data visualization. While I understand this position is entry-level, my background has taught me how important careful data handling, consistency, and clear communication are in day-to-day work. I’m comfortable following instructions closely, keeping information organized, and making sure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

For a job like this, I would focus on clean and reliable data entry, maintaining spreadsheets, checking for errors, and keeping records well structured. I’m also used to working in Excel and Google Sheets, so I can adapt quickly to your workflow and formatting needs. Because I have experience with data cleaning and analysis, I pay attention to detail and can spot inconsistencies that might otherwise be missed. If the work involves simple database updates or document-based tasks, I can handle those carefully as well.

I’m especially interested in opportunities where I can contribute steadily while continuing to learn. I’m a fast learner, open to feedback, and comfortable working on tasks that require accuracy and repetition. I understand the value of being dependable in an entry-level role, and I would approach this job with professionalism, focus, and a positive attitude.

If you’re looking for someone who can start quickly, follow directions well, and help keep your data organized and accurate, I’d be happy to contribute. I’m ready to put in the effort to support your team and grow with the role.

Would you like me to focus more on spreadsheet-based work, database entry, or written content tasks for this position?
